name: Flight Stabilizer
description: Takes a seat's controls and flies the craft: link its outputs to thrusters, flaps and gimbals.

config.label: Keys
config.tooltip: What the keys mean. Auto: wings and a forward push make it a plane, nozzles a rocket, anything else a rotorcraft. It finds what it can use by itself.

config.label: Preset
config.tooltip: What auto means below: gentle, as it comes, or lively. Anything you set yourself stays.

config.label: Strength
config.tooltip: How hard it corrects. Lower it if the craft shakes.

config.label: Stabilise level
config.tooltip: Off: the keys ask for turning, and it stays at whatever angle you leave it.

config.label: Mouse aim
config.tooltip: It flies where the seat looks.

config.label: Invert pitch
config.tooltip: W lifts the nose and S drops it.

config.label: Max lean
config.tooltip: The most it leans. 0: the pattern's own.

config.label: Max turn
config.tooltip: The fastest it turns. 0: the pattern's own.

config.label: Max climb
config.tooltip: The fastest it climbs. 0: the pattern's own.

config.label: Max speed
config.tooltip: The speed the keys ask for. 0: the pattern's own.

config.label: Max descent
config.tooltip: The fastest it comes down. 0: as Max climb.

config.label: Trim, nose up
config.tooltip: What it counts as level, nose up.

config.label: Trim, right wing down
config.tooltip: What it counts as level, right wing down.

config.label: Autopilot
config.tooltip: On: it holds what the mode says. Its input and the Flight Panel set this too.

config.label: Mode
config.tooltip: What it holds.

config.label: Altitude
config.tooltip: The height held. 0: where it was when engaged.

config.label: Heading
config.tooltip: The heading held, clockwise from north. -1: where it pointed when engaged.

config.label: Waypoint x
config.tooltip: The point it flies to, world x.

config.label: Waypoint z
config.tooltip: The point it flies to, world z.

config.label: Rate limit
config.tooltip: The fastest it turns this way. 0: Max turn.

config.label: Response (P)
config.tooltip: How hard it goes for what is asked. Up: quicker; too much rocks. 0: auto.

config.label: Damping (D)
config.tooltip: How hard it stops. Up: less overshoot; too much shakes. 0: auto.

config.label: Hold (I)
config.tooltip: How it works off a steady push. Up: it holds tighter; too much wanders. 0: auto.

config.label: Expo
config.tooltip: Soft around the middle of a wired stick. A key is all or nothing.

config.label: Throttle curve
config.tooltip: Above 0: finer low down. Below 0: finer high up.

config.label: Max bank
config.tooltip: The most it banks. 0: Max lean.

config.label: Max pitch
config.tooltip: The most it pitches. 0: Max lean.

config.label: Turn coordination
config.tooltip: How much the rudder follows a bank. 0: auto, all of it.

config.label: Auto-level
config.tooltip: How hard it comes level when let go. 0: auto.

config.label: Wind hold
config.tooltip: How fast it leans into a steady drift. 0: auto.

config.label: Landing assist
config.tooltip: Below this height it comes down gently. 0: off.

config.label: Collective range
config.tooltip: The most of its rotors' push it uses. 0: all of it.

config.label: Thrust limit
config.tooltip: The most of its thrusters' push it uses. 0: all of it.
